sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. A planning estimate is available, subject to assumptions. Treat it as guidance rather than a promise about live service.

The workload estimate is 8 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_B200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_H200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 16). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The workload estimate and chosen hardware differ in scope. Use this to discuss factory headroom, but spare capacity does not establish how many customers can share it.

Required memory per GPU: 56 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 2048 GB. Host local disk provision: 30720 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Working memory is judged per device, so combined totals alone can mislead. Host memory and disk figures are planning assumptions to review.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Shared storage capacity is still unresolved, not absent by default. Decide separately whether outside files must be copied in.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and communication between GPUs need measured follow-up. Do not combine overlapping traffic views.
